gates.title: Flights booked
gates.detail: 11 Dec arrival 12:25; 18 Dec departure 13:05 via Chennai. Return T1 connection: one hour. Shared PDF covers two; all five use the same services per traveller confirmation.

gates.title: Exotica: fifth adult & extra bed
gates.detail: Voucher covers four, with no extra bed. Confirm the fifth adult and fee at 15 Dec check-in; ₹3,000 is a reserve. Base booking: ₹14,450.

gates.title: Pibo booked for five
gates.detail: 17–18 Dec · Family Room + Super Deluxe · ₹4,004.70 incl. GST, room only. Check-in 10:00; checkout 09:00; rooms ready after the ferry.

gates.title: Baratang package confirmed · ₹10,000
gates.detail: Includes first airport pickup, cab and five cave-speedboat tickets. ₹1,000 token requested, payment unverified. Driver/timing and local extras to confirm; keep ₹13,000 overall.

gates.title: Snorkelling confirmed
gates.detail: Turquoise Dream confirmed the booking in WhatsApp. Five adults · 16 Dec at 10:00 · agreed 45-minute option. ₹8,673 remains; arrange your own reporting-point ride.

gates.title: Confirm early activity pickups
gates.detail: Confirm scuba on 13 Dec and kayak on 14 Dec. On Neil arrival, arrange your own snorkelling ride and reporting buffer.

gates.title: Arrange local rides
gates.detail: Book for five adults plus bags. First airport pickup is included; settle early ferry rides the previous evening. Arrange Pibo bag storage after 09:00 checkout on 18 Dec.

gates.title: 4 Dec · 09:00 · Jail-show reminder
gates.detail: Book five for 11 Dec when released: 17:50 Hindi preferred, 18:50 English fallback. Museum entry is separate. Tickets not bought yet.

gates.title: Settle balances when due
gates.detail: Water activities: ₹41,173 remaining. Count advances once; confirm Pibo’s ₹2,000 allocation and the final extra-adult charge at settlement.

11.headline: 12:25 ticketed arrival · museum 15:00–16:00 · show still to book
11.tonight: Confirm tomorrow’s Baratang driver, pickup/convoy, waiting and local extras. Eat and sleep early.
11.protect: If delayed, move the museum to 17 Dec afternoon.

12.headline: ~03:00 cab pickup · confirm with the driver
take: Original photo ID for all five
Water, snacks + cash for agreed local charges
12.tonight: Pack for Havelock and arrange tomorrow’s jetty drop.
12.protect: Confirm the return convoy and local extras. Mud Volcano is optional; main bags stay at the hotel.

13.headline: Report at Haddo 11:30 · ferry sails 12:30
13.tonight: Confirm scuba pickup and an early or packed breakfast. Sleep early.
13.protect: Radhanagar is optional; skip it if check-in or rest runs late.

14.headline: 05:30 scuba slot · pickup time still to confirm
14.tonight: Pack bags; confirm kayak pickup, return and breakfast.
14.protect: Keep the morning free until ~10:00. Confirm pickup; the office pin isn’t the meeting point.

15.headline: 03:30 kayak · report for Makruzz at 12:30
15.status: Kayak + ferry booked · fifth adult to check
15.tonight: Arrange tomorrow’s snorkelling ride and reporting time.
15.protect: Protect 12:30 ferry reporting. Sunset only if ready by ~16:00; confirm Exotica’s fifth-adult fee at check-in.

16.headline: 10:00 snorkelling · confirm the reporting buffer
take: Agreed payment method for ₹8,673 group balance
16.tonight: Pack; confirm early breakfast, checkout and the 08:30 jetty report.
16.protect: Bridge only at a suitable daylight low tide; back by ~08:15. Keep 09:15–12:30 clear for snorkelling.

17.headline: Report at Neil jetty 08:30 · ferry sails 09:30
17.tonight: Pack for 09:00 checkout; arrange bag storage and the airport car.
17.protect: Sunrise must preserve 08:30 reporting. Choose one afternoon outing; Jail is a fallback if missed.

18.headline: Pibo checkout 09:00 · airport target 10:45–11:00 · flight 13:05
take: Both boarding passes; one-hour Chennai T1 transfer
18.tonight: Check rooms and the car for belongings.
18.protect: Checkout 09:00; pickup target 10:15–10:30, airport 10:45–11:00. Flights 13:05–15:20, then 16:20–17:25.

reminders.activation: General preparation and trip reminders remain inactive until preparation starts. The explicitly requested one-time Cellular Jail booking check is separately scheduled for 4 Dec at 09:00 IST.
reminders.audience: Team andaman group plus each member individually; verify the then-current group roster privately before sending.
reminders.noisePolicy: Only useful alerts. Bundle preparation tasks, avoid duplicate reminders, no alerts for optional sightseeing; notify again only for a material time/location change or unresolved essential action.

preparation.what: One combined documents, forms, balances, packing and transfer checklist; include the single itinerary link.
One final essentials check; omit tasks already completed.

trip.when: One next-day briefing in the evening
trip.what: Tomorrow’s first essential time, pickup/report pin, what to carry and what needs confirmation. Avoid separate alerts for each optional stop.

trip.when: Before an essential departure or reporting deadline
trip.what: One practical leave-now alert based on the confirmed pickup/route plus buffer. Suppress it when an arranged driver pickup already covers the same action.

reminders.channels: A static website cannot send scheduled WhatsApp notifications. Calendar/reminder alerts and any WhatsApp delivery must be configured and tested in the preparation phase; delivery is not active or guaranteed by this plan.

scheduledExceptions.name: Cellular Jail show booking check
scheduledExceptions.purpose: Check and remind to book five adults for 11 Dec; no payment made by the reminder.
